scenario: A translational oncology team studying ipsc derived neurons performs the following experiment: A clinical lab sequences tumor biopsies from 50 cancer patients without matched germline blood samples, calls variants using Mutect2 in tumor-only mode, and labels all non-synonymous variants as somatic oncogenic drivers. They collect samples and execute computational modeling.
question: Critique the methodology of this ipsc derived neurons study. Identify any fatal methodological flaws, explain the underlying biological and statistical mechanisms, provide rigorous corrections, and establish whether reported biological claims are warranted.
ground_truth_rationale: Authoritative scientific rationale: Without matched normal sequencing, rare private germline polymorphisms cannot be distinguished from somatic mutations. High tumor-only variant counts conflate benign inherited variation with tumor mutations. In ipsc_derived_neurons biology, failing to account for this leads to erroneous translational conclusions.
